claims.text: TotalEnergies implemented an Experion Operations Assistant pilot project on the delayed coker unit (DCU) and control room at its refinery in Port Arthur, Texas.
claims.quote: TotalEnergies recently implemented an Experion Operations Assistant pilot project on the delayed coker unit (DCU) and control room at its refinery in Port Arthur, Texas.

claims.text: The refinery typically processes 238,000 barrels per day of complex crude in its 47 process units.
claims.quote: It typically processes 238,000 bpd of complex crude in its 47 process units, and DCU and fluid catalytic cracking (FCC) conversion units.

claims.text: A delayed coker uses high heat to thermally crack heavy residual oil into lighter, more valuable products such as coker naphtha and gas oil.
claims.quote: DCUs typically use high heat to thermally crack heavy, residual oil into lighter, more valuable products, such as coker naphtha and gas oil.

claims.text: Occasional disruptions to boilers and other steam-generating systems cause pressure dips that lead to compressor trips, resulting in plant shutdowns and flaring.
claims.quote: Occasional disruptions to boilers and other steam-generating systems; Pressure dips caused by the disturbances, which lead to compressor trips, resulting in plant shutdowns, flaring and other disruptions;

claims.text: Operators have limited time to make informed steam-shedding decisions for non-critical equipment.
claims.quote: Limited time to make informed, steam-shedding decisions for non-critical equipment.

claims.text: The Experion Operations Assistant AI and ML models predicted pressure dips 10 to 18 minutes earlier than before.
claims.quote: Experion Operations Assistant integrated AI and ML models were able to predict pressure dips 10-18 minutes earlier than before, and enable more proactive operator responses to mitigate them.

claims.text: Operators acted on at least two AI-based alerts after the steam model was implemented.
claims.quote: So far, our operators have acted on at least two AI-based alerts since the model was implemented, which validated its real-time useability.

claims.text: The drum-level prediction model achieved 75% prediction accuracy but was not retained, because drum switching depends on conditions beyond the model's scope.
claims.quote: The drum-level prediction model achieved 75% prediction accuracy, but drum switching also depends on conditions beyond the model’s scope, so this use case wasn’t retained,

claims.text: The heater spalling model achieved about 75% prediction accuracy with two-hour updates over a typical 28 to 30 day cycle, and its outputs closely matched operator experience.
claims.quote: In fact, it achieved about 75% prediction accuracy with two-hour updates over a typical 28- to 30-day cycle," said Klein. "Its outputs also closely matched operator experiences and key process adjustments.

claims.text: Enhanced Alarm Decision Support was deployed on more than 300 coker tags and created high value for new and line-of-progression operators.
claims.quote: EADS was deployed on more than 300 coker tags, and subsequent alarm guidance was validated and approved by TotalEnergies subject matter experts. ... Overall, Klein reported that EADS created high value for new and line-of-progression operators.

claims.text: Thomas Klein said there is room for AI on the DCU console though it is not plug-and-play and needs support, and advised getting operators involved from the beginning.
claims.quote: I was pessimistic about it, but there’s definitely room for it on our DCU console, though it’s not plug-and-play and needs support," Klein said. ... "Our advice is getting operators involved in with deploying AI from the beginning, so they succeed with it on their consoles.

claims.text: TotalEnergies and Honeywell launched the pilot in October 2024, and Klein presented the AI project at Honeywell User Group Americas 2026, Honeywell's user conference, in Phoenix.
claims.quote: TotalEnergies partnered with Honeywell, launching its pilot in October 2024. | who presented its AI project on the second day of Honeywell User Group Americas 2026 in Phoenix this week. | June 11, 2026

claims.text: Preliminary results show the tool forecasted five potential events, with predictions made an average of 12 minutes in advance of an alarm incident.
claims.quote: Preliminary results show the AI-assisted solution has successfully forecasted five potential events, helping to minimize downtime and reduce emissions from flaring. The predictions were made an average of 12 minutes in advance of an alarm incident, enabling operators to quickly implement corrective actions before an event.

claims.text: The initiative aims to support and empower operators to make timely and informed decisions.
claims.quote: The initiative aims to support and empower operators to make timely and informed decisions while also providing the opportunity to enhance operational autonomy.

claims.text: Honeywell announced the pilot on November 11th, 2025, describing Experion Operations Assistant as an AI-powered solution built on its distributed control system that lets control room operators forecast potential maintenance events before they happen.
claims.quote: With the integration of this new solution, operators in the control room can forecast potential maintenance events before they happen and minimize risks associated with unsafe operations and production losses.

claims.text: TotalEnergies lists Port Arthur's commissioning as 1936 and its crude processing capacity as 238,000 barrels per day.
claims.quote: Commissioning: 1936 | grown to become a major petrochemical platform with a crude processing capacity of 238,000 barrels per day.

claims.text: Port Arthur is in southeast Jefferson County, seventeen miles southeast of Beaumont.
claims.quote: Port Arthur is on State Highway 87 on the lower west bank of Sabine Lake, five miles east of the Neches River Rainbow Bridge and seventeen miles southeast of Beaumont in southeast Jefferson County.

claims.text: The steam disturbance prediction use case started in May 2025 and closed a year later. Drum cycling and spalling started in July 2025 and alarm guidance in January 2026.
claims.quote: Steam disturbance prediction, which started in May 2025, and closed a year later; Drum cycling and spalling, which both started in July 2025; and, Alarm guidance, which started in January 2026.

claims.text: Klein said the steam disturbance use case was the first time at the site that AI detected a situation it had predicted.
claims.quote: The steam disturbance UC was the first time at our site that AI detected a situation it had predicted,

claims.text: The coker was chosen first because it is a continuous batch process with real-time console-based operating decisions, where AI could give operators more data ahead of time to act sooner on pressure drops.
claims.quote: We decided to do AI on the coker unit first because it’s a continuous batch process with console-based operating decisions in real-time, and it has some constraints like scheduling and other common challenges that AI could help address, such as giving operators more data ahead of time, so they could act sooner in response to changes like pressure drops,

claims.text: Experion Operations Assistant uses the Experion Python Module and enhanced alarm decision support, integrated with Total's HALO Lookahead Runway.
claims.quote: To perform the tasks needed to accomplish these goals, Experion Operations Assistant employs its Experion Python Module and enhanced alarm decision support and integrates them with Total’s HALO Lookahead Runway.

claims.text: Continuous high-pressure steam is critical for turbine operations, and steam shortages in overhead pressure lines raise the chance of flaring.
claims.quote: Continuous high-pressure steam is critical for turbine operations, but steam shortages in elevated, overhead pressure lines increase the possibility of flaring.

claims.text: For drum cycling, the tool calculates and displays drum status, out-of-sync warnings and delay decoking alerts for HALO.
claims.quote: Likewise, Experion Operations Assistant calculates and displays drum status, out-of-sync warnings and delay decoking alerts for HALO.

claims.text: EADS draws on past events, alarms and P&IDs and shows examples of what happened before and the best response at that time.
claims.quote: EADS takes past events, alarms, P&IDs and other inputs, puts them in a manageable form, and gives real-world examples of what happened before and what was the best response at that time.

claims.text: EADS was made available to the DCU's operators and is in an extended evaluation period.
claims.quote: It was subsequently made available for the DCU’s operators and is presently in an extended evaluation period.

claims.text: The Port Arthur coker was built in 2011, which with the 1990s FCC lets the site process heavy crude.
claims.quote: Modernization projects including the construction of the Company’s largest fluidized-bed catalytic cracker (FCC) in the 1990s, and a coker in 2011 have enabled the site to process heavy crude oil as well as lighter domestic crudes.

claims.text: Raphael Duflos, VP and General Manager of TotalEnergies' Port Arthur Platform, said the solution could contribute to safer operations, reduced downtime and minimized product losses.
claims.quote: We believe this solution could contribute to safer operations, reduced downtime, and minimized product losses.

claims.text: Thomas Klein is a process control professional at Total's Port Arthur facility.
claims.quote: said Thomas Klein, process control professional at Total’s Port Arthur facility

claims.text: Honeywell's release announcing the pilot and its preliminary results is dated November 11th, 2025.
claims.quote: HOUSTON, Nov. 11, 2025 /PRNewswire/

cautions: Lead times disagree. Control Global (June 2026) says 10 to 18 minutes earlier. Honeywell (November 2025, preliminary) says an average of 12 minutes before an alarm incident. Never merge them.
Do not use the ambiguous 85 percent accuracy line.
Five potential events, not five pressure dips. No source says a compressor trip was prevented.
No source says operators shed steam in response to an AI alert. They acted on at least two alerts.
Pilot. Steam use case closed after a year. EADS in extended evaluation. Not refinery-wide.
Only drum cycling is said to be not retained.
Both sources are tied to Honeywell. Control Global piece is sponsored coverage.
Klein is a process control professional at the Port Arthur facility.
